mergedMilestones.summary: Detached continuous process-field projection contracts and shadow-only diagnostic authority registration.
Deterministic great-circle compact-support projection, coordinate queries, disposable grids, reviewed epoch-overlap lineage, and bounded evaluation.

blockedOrNegativeEvidence: A spine paired with a history whose epoch identities do not overlap must be rejected.
A projection with no kernels must be rejected.
Artificial or fantasy premise exceptions remain outside the natural history-to-spine-to-projection route.
requiredEvidence: controlled, threshold, ice-shell, and holdout coverage
no legacy morphology or physical writes

phaseDGates.evidence: All fields remain continuous great-circle queries; diagnostic grids are sampled artifacts rather than source authority.
Every nonzero source-anchor family query must identify a matching dominant kernel and source node.
Cold rocky dwarf, mixed terrestrial, hot super-Earth, tidal threshold, ice-shell, and two holdouts are exercised.
Sampling multiple grids may not alter the projection record or exact coordinate-query values.
Incompatible history/spine lineage and empty-kernel artifacts are rejected.
Projection creation, exact queries, and two diagnostic resolutions remain within committed CI budgets.
The process writes diagnostics only; processFieldAuthority, structuralRoleAuthority, terrain, land/water, and renderer authority remain absent.

knownLimitations.description: D2 kernels are radial compact-support influence fields. They do not independently encode oriented ridges, arcs, sutures, transforms, elongated rifts, or corridor geometry.
Published preservation weights are diagnostic visibility assumptions and are not physically calibrated.
Wave 1 direct-input downstream relations remain research-required rather than reviewed.
Phase D fields do not decide continent, ocean basin, shelf, transitional crust, or uncertain structural roles.

phaseCEntryBoundary.firstScope: C1 immutable structural-role interpretation contracts, provenance, ambiguity, and authority isolation
